ev.q: CDC made recommendations for a single bivalent vaccine dose for most persons aged ≥6 years, bivalent vaccines for children aged 6 months–5 years

equity.level_reason: Age only defines the population and the recommendation groups; no social-position framing. Equity is named only as an EtR consideration.

A rare risk for myocarditis and pericarditis has been identified after receipt of monovalent mRNA COVID-19 vaccines, primarily in adolescent and young adult males.

notes: All quantities (VE with CIs, coverage, hospitalization rates, seroprevalence, trial GMRs with a superiority criterion) are cited from other reports or trials, so they are not the article's own procedures. vaccine_outcome_type left null because the report quantifies nothing itself; a reader could argue effectiveness from the cited VE.
